subject.title: [Bug]: When openclaw sends a link with an underscore to Feishu, the full hyperlink cannot be displayed

question: Should maintainers sponsor a fresh same-repository Feishu URL-boundary fix, or adopt and repair one of the existing candidate branches for this bug?
rationale: The bug is valid and narrow, but the issue is already marked no-new-fix-pr/needs-maintainer-review and prior candidate branches conflict or closed unmerged, so another automatic branch could add duplicate churn without a maintainer choosing the landing path.

options.title: Sponsor a fresh same-repository fix
options.body: Queue one narrow Feishu plugin fix with regression tests and live Feishu proof, using the closed PRs only as source context.

options.title: Adopt an existing candidate
options.body: Pick the best candidate branch, resolve conflicts, and require focused coverage plus real Feishu behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Wait for contributor update
options.body: Keep this issue open until a contributor updates a candidate into a mergeable, proven target.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a fresh same-repository fix
recommendation.body: Queue one narrow Feishu plugin fix with regression tests and live Feishu proof, using the closed PRs only as source context.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger has the strongest recent history across the central Feishu send/outbound/post files and is the best available routing candidate for the landing-path choice.
